title: Brainwashed Into Your New Toy (ORIGINAL)
description: I've spent so long taking you down into trance. How about just this one time, in a twist of fate, you try your hand at hypnotizing me. I say hand... more like... pocket watch. Such a pretty pocket watch and it does look nice when you swing it back and forth like that. Back and forth... back and forth... Y-yes, I’ll keep looking at the watch. Can you resist the chance to condition and brainwash me into your obedient toy I wonder. So... Have I… Ever been hypnotized? Y-you’re saying that I feel good when I do what you say? Yes… that makes perfect sense. Of course I’ll do anything you say. It feels good to obey...
author: Mistress Shibby
